name: What should I prepare before engaging a contractor for project management?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before engaging a contractor for project management?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before engaging a contractor for project management, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your renovation goals, desired aesthetic, and a preliminary budget range. Gathering inspirational images, making a list of 'must-haves' versus 'nice-to-haves,' and understanding your general timeline expectations will help the project manager create a more accurate proposal and scope for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your renovation goals, aesthetic preferences, budget range, and timeline expectations before engaging a project manager.
